summary: Build practical health system diagnostics, planning, and reporting skills in 5 days. Strengthen delivery, resilience, and coordination.
lede: Health systems strengthening focuses on assessing service delivery, workforce, information, financing, and governance to identify system gaps. For health programme managers, planners, monitoring and evaluation officers, and administrators, this training develops practical skills in bottleneck analysis, routine data quality checks, and KPI dashboard design. Participants use these findings to prioritize constraints and prepare improvement plans and implementation roadmaps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who diagnose system gaps, coordinate improvement plans, and report on health system performance across facilities, programmes, and partners.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: You should have working familiarity with health service delivery, programme operations, or public health management. Prior exposure to routine monitoring data, supervision reports, or health facility performance review is helpful. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable interpreting indicators, basic dashboards, and planning documents. This is an advanced course, so it is best suited to professionals already responsible for planning, coordination, analysis, or oversight in health systems strengthening.
